11560.name: Caleb Williams

brief.prose: Chicago's franchise quarterback in Ben Johnson's offense, and the job is not in question, but he is out again in Week 4, his second straight miss. ESPN reports the hamstring is a Grade 2 strain with a three-to-four-week recovery window, and he did not practice Friday. Tyson Bagent, cleared from his concussion and taking most of the first-team reps this week, is expected to start against the Jets with Case Keenum, who threw three touchdowns in the Week 3 win over Philadelphia, as the backup. Johnson has declined to name a starter publicly. On return, a strained hamstring also blunts the scrambling that carries much of his rushing value, so the first game back may be a pocket-only version.
brief.rationale: Starter job secure, but a Grade 2 strain with a 3-4 week window keeps him out Week 4 and likely beyond, and the rushing component should lag on return.
